why: Конструкция have something done описывает ситуацию, когда действие выполняем не мы сами, а кто-то другой, обычно за услугу: «Я подстригся (в парикмахерской)» = I had my hair cut. Также её используют, когда с нами случается неприятность: «У него украли телефон». В русском для этого хватает одного глагола, а в английском без этой конструкции получится, что вы сделали всё сами.
formation: Формула: have + что-то (объект) + V3 (третья форма глагола). Время показывает только have.
• Present Simple: I have my car washed every week.
• Past Simple: I had my car washed yesterday.
• Present Continuous: I am having my car washed now.
• Present Perfect: I have had my car washed.
• Future: I will have my car washed tomorrow.
• С модальным: You should have your eyes checked.
Отрицание и вопросы строим как с обычным смысловым have, через do/does/did: Do you have your hair cut here? I didn't have my laptop repaired. Where did you have your suit made?
Разговорный вариант: get + объект + V3 — I got my phone fixed.
usage: 1. Услуга, которую нам оказывают: We are having our flat painted. (Нам красят квартиру.)
2. Неприятное событие, которое с нами случилось: She had her bag stolen on the bus. (У неё украли сумку в автобусе.)
3. Просьба или совет: You need to have your passport renewed. (Вам нужно обновить паспорт.)
4. Неформально: I need to get my car serviced. (Мне нужно отдать машину на обслуживание.)
signalWords: Услуги и специалисты: hairdresser, dentist, mechanic, tailor, plumber, at the salon, every month, twice a year.
mistakes: ✗ I cut my hair yesterday. (в парикмахерской) → ✓ I had my hair cut yesterday. (иначе получается, что вы сами стригли себя)
✗ I had my car repair. → ✓ I had my car repaired. (после объекта нужна третья форма)
✗ I had repaired my car. → ✓ I had my car repaired. (had repaired — это Past Perfect, и ремонт сделали вы сами)
✗ Where do you have cut your hair? → ✓ Where do you have your hair cut? (объект стоит между have и V3)
✗ She has her hair cutted. → ✓ She has her hair cut. (cut — неправильный глагол, форма не меняется)
remember: have + что-то + V3 = «мне это сделали»; время меняем только у have.

items.prompt: I ___ my laptop ___ (fix) last week.
items.answer: had / fixed

items.prompt: We ___ our house ___ (paint) at the moment.
items.answer: are having / painted

items.answer: has / cut

items.answer: have / washed

items.answer: have / installed

items.answer: had / checked

items.answer: has had / renewed

items.answer: have / delivered

items.answer: (b) have my eyes checked

items.answer: (b) had my wallet stolen

items.answer: (a) get

items.answer: (b) have your suit made

items.answer: (a) got his bike stolen

exercises.instruction: Перепишите с конструкцией have something done

items.prompt: A mechanic repaired my car yesterday. (I ...)
items.answer: I had my car repaired yesterday.

items.prompt: A photographer is taking our photo. (We ...)
items.answer: We are having our photo taken.

items.prompt: Someone delivers our groceries every Friday. (We ...)
items.answer: We have our groceries delivered every Friday.

items.prompt: A plumber will fix my sink tomorrow. (I ...)
items.answer: I will have my sink fixed tomorrow.

items.prompt: A dentist checks Tom's teeth twice a year. (Tom ...)
items.answer: Tom has his teeth checked twice a year.

items.prompt: Someone broke into her car last night. (She ...)
items.answer: She had her car broken into last night.

items.prompt: A tailor shortened my trousers. (I ...)
items.answer: I had my trousers shortened.

items.prompt: Someone cut down the old tree in our garden last week. (We ...)
items.answer: We had the old tree in our garden cut down last week.

items.prompt: Make a question: you / your hair / cut / where (present simple)
items.answer: Where do you have your hair cut?

items.prompt: Make it negative: I had my car washed.
items.answer: I didn't have my car washed. / I did not have my car washed.

items.prompt: Make a yes/no question: She had her flat painted.
items.answer: Did she have her flat painted?

items.prompt: Make it negative: We are having the roof repaired.
items.answer: We aren't having the roof repaired. / We are not having the roof repaired.

items.prompt: Make a yes/no question: He has his shirts ironed.
items.answer: Does he have his shirts ironed?

items.prompt: Make a question (past): when / you / your laptop / fix
items.answer: When did you have your laptop fixed?

items.prompt: Make it negative: They will have the windows replaced.
items.answer: They won't have the windows replaced. / They will not have the windows replaced.

items.prompt: Make a question: You've had your eyes tested.
items.answer: Have you had your eyes tested?

items.prompt: Я стригусь раз в месяц.
items.answer: I have my hair cut once a month.

items.prompt: Вчера мне починили ноутбук.
items.answer: I had my laptop repaired yesterday. / I had my laptop fixed yesterday.

items.prompt: Нам сейчас красят квартиру.
items.answer: We are having our apartment painted now. / We are having our flat painted now.

items.prompt: У него украли телефон в метро.
items.answer: He had his phone stolen on the subway. / He got his phone stolen on the subway.

items.prompt: Где ты обслуживаешь машину?
items.answer: Where do you have your car serviced?

items.prompt: Мне нужно проверить зрение.
items.answer: I need to have my eyes checked. / I need to have my eyes tested.

items.prompt: Завтра нам установят новый кондиционер.
items.answer: We are having a new air conditioner installed tomorrow. / We will have a new air conditioner installed tomorrow.

items.prompt: Она сфотографировалась для паспорта.
items.answer: She had her photo taken for her passport. / She had her picture taken for her passport.
